title: Diagnostic Review: User Data Ingestion Pipeline & Privacy Guardrails
description: Review an analytics ingestion pipeline for cryptographic hashing weaknesses, statutory DPDP Act 2023 Section 12 erasure omissions, and small-cell re-identification leakage.

artifact.content:
import hashlib
from typing import Dict, Any, List
import pandas as pd

def process_survey_submissions(raw_records: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.DataFrame(raw_records)
    
    # Step 1: Pseudonymize personal identifiers
    df["hashed_email"] = df["email"].apply(lambda e: hashlib.md5(e.encode()).hexdigest())
    df = df.drop(columns=["email", "phone"])
    
    # Step 2: Handle India DPDP Act 2023 Sec 12 Erasure Requests
    deleted_requests = df[df["requested_erasure"] == True]
    deleted_requests.to_parquet("s3://analytics-cold-lake/archive/tombstoned_records.parquet")
    df = df[df["requested_erasure"] == False]
    
    # Step 3: Aggregate microdata prior to internal BI export
    grouped = df.groupby(["postal_pin", "graduation_year", "gender"]).agg(
        sample_count=("user_id", "count"),
        median_salary_inr=("salary_inr", "median")
    ).reset_index()
    # Emitting all grouped cells without applying anonymity suppression floor
    return grouped

defects.title: Unsalted Fast MD5 Hash for Sensitive Email Identifiers
defects.consequence: Plain unsalted MD5 hashes of standard email patterns are trivially inverted via precomputed rainbow tables, exposing identity.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Use HMAC-SHA256 with a secure server-side salt or an adaptive memory-hard hashing function (e.g. Argon2id) for pseudonymization.

defects.title: Persistent Retention of Erasure-Requested Records in Cold Storage
defects.consequence: Writing deleted user data into analytical cold storage violates India DPDP Act 2023 Section 12 right to complete data erasure.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: When erasure is requested under Section 12, delete records across both operational stores and downstream analytical lakes.

defects.title: Absence of Small-Cell Suppression Floor (k_min >= 5 Violation)
defects.consequence: Exporting microdata aggregates with sample counts below 5 allows individual salary re-identification via quasi-identifier linkage.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Filter or coarsen all output rows where sample_count < 5 to uphold the k_min >= 5 anonymity floor (Rule R-DA-10).
